dct_description_sm: This data set includes kinematic and kinetic data from students at the University of Guelph. This was recorded while completing the multiple-object tracking task while either seated or standing. Quiet stance and seated trials were also recorded as a baseline. Also included in this data set is the accuracy results (percentage of targets correctly identified) from the multiple-object tracking task.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for:  What Is the Role of Sustained Visual Attention in the Maintenance of Postural Control in Young Adults?
